title: Count to Five
yt_description:
In this fun song, your child will learn to count from 1 to 5 with everyday objects. Pip and friends will show you how to make learning fun and easy. Encourage your child to sing along and count with us!

🎵 Count to Five

Hello
Let's count
With me

One apple
Two balls
Let's count

Count to five
It's easy
Let's try

Three swings
Four blocks
Let's count

Count to five
It's easy
Bye bye

Bouncy Meadow — Kids Songs with Pip, Lulu & Bo
Animation and music created with AI tools, written and reviewed by a human.

#Shorts #KidsSongs #counting #numbers #toddlers
